decision: Representative Arrival and Elio Kitchen pairs support a partial canon-ready direction; EP1-wide canon, desktop artistic acceptance, and runtime visual acceptance remain unverified. The three missing desktop variants remain a hard dual-format blocker.

findings.detail: Portrait and desktop kitchen layouts require a cue-bound check as valid alternate angles of one location.
The knife pose may read as threatening and requires comparison with the exact authored cue.
Low suitcase and lower kitchen staging require runtime checks with the dialogue sheet open.
Desktop variants are absent for ep1-leo-harbor-cg, ep1-leo-night-cg, and ep1-hook-cg.
